gloss: boisterous revelry; noisy partying; rowdy merrymaking

definitions.gloss: boisterous revelry; noisy partying; rowdy merrymaking
definitions.explanation: Loud, exuberant celebration or partying, typically involving drinking, singing, and general noise. Often implies excessive or disruptive merriment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧どんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They're having a rowdy party next door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep last night because of the rowdy revelry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧どんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We partied rowdily until morning at the year-end party.

notes:
"どんちゃん" is an onomatopoeic expression imitating the sounds of drums and cymbals (⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドンドン⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉦|かね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧チャンチャン), suggesting festive noise.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to have a rowdy party
- どんちゃん{騒|さわ}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to turn into a rowdy scene

The word has a slightly negative or exasperated tone when used by someone not participating, but a fun, self-deprecating tone when used by the participants themselves.
